extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, and the general public looking for NIDA news and media resources
extracted.subtask_description: A government health-agency news page that publishes official press releases, multimedia, and event notices about research findings and agency activities. The page organizes items by type (News Release, Video, Meeting/Event) and provides media resources and contact options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content-type labeling (e.g., 'News Release', 'Video', 'Meeting/Event')
rubrics_metrics.description: Each item is explicitly labeled with its content type such as 'News Release', 'Video', or 'Meeting/Event'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Labels allow readers to immediately identify the format and expectations of the item (e.g., a 'News Release' will be a media announcement; a 'Video' may have a transcript). Use clear, prominent content-type tags for each entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline / Title
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise descriptive headline is shown for each item (e.g., 'NIH researchers discover pain-relieving drug with minimal addictive properties').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Headlines should summarize the key news in a clear, attention-getting way suitable for media pickup and linking from indexes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication date
rubrics_metrics.description: Each news item displays a publication date (e.g., 'April 1, 2026').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an explicit, readable date with each release so readers and reporters can place the item in temporal context and cite it accurately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short summary / teaser line
rubrics_metrics.description: A one-line summary or teaser follows the headline to provide immediate context (e.g., 'Positive safety profile of novel drug compound is surprise for class of synthetic opioids shelved years ago.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a short explanatory sentence that succinctly communicates the core finding or news hook for quick scanning by journalists and the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia and image inclusion with credit
rubrics_metrics.description: Items may include images and videos; images carry credit lines (e.g., '©iStock/ skynesher').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include relevant images or video to illustrate the story and supply proper credits/attribution. For videos, provide playback and descriptive thumbnails where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video transcripts available ('View Transcript')
rubrics_metrics.description: Videos on the page include links to transcripts indicated by 'View Transcript'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full transcripts for videos to improve accessibility, enable quoting, and help journalists extract facts without replaying media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact the press office / media list
rubrics_metrics.description: A call-to-action: 'Contact our press office to be added to our media list or to arrange an interview.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make press office contact information and procedures explicit so media can request interviews, clarifications, or be added to distribution lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and social channels ('Follow us on Twitter' / 'subscribe to our RSS feed')
rubrics_metrics.description: The page invites readers to 'Follow us on Twitter or subscribe to our RSS feed to receive our news releases.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer clear subscription and social media options so journalists and stakeholders can receive timely updates; prominently display links and instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curated sections ('Featured' and 'Latest News')
rubrics_metrics.description: The site distinguishes highlighted content under 'Featured' and chronological items under 'Latest News'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use curated featured slots for high-priority announcements and a chronological feed for all recent releases to guide readers to important items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resources for the Media (linked resource list)
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'Resources for the Media' area lists items such as 'Congressional Testimonies', 'Research Topics', 'Infographics', 'Nora's Blog', 'PubMed Central', 'RePORTER', 'EurekAlert', and 'Policy Briefs'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a centralized set of media resources and links (data, backgrounders, infographics, databases) so journalists can research and contextualize stories quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Events listing with date/time/location
rubrics_metrics.description: Upcoming meetings/events are listed with title, date, time, and physical location details (e.g., 'NIH IRP GLP-1 Workshop — Friday, July 24, 2026 — Masur Auditorium – Building 10 NIH Bethesda Campus').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When public events are announced, include full logistical details (date, start/end times, venue) and an obvious path to additional event info or registration.
